exposure: Implementation of Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) Steps 1-9
cohort: The study included 903 mother-infant pairs of women who gave birth to a healthy singleton between May 24 and August 25, 2012, in one of six facilities in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo.
finding: Implementation of BFHI Steps 1-9 or 1-10 was associated with a reduction in postpartum depressive symptoms relative to standard of care, with the largest decrease observed in the Steps 1-10 group, particularly among women reporting breastfeeding difficulties.
